crossRefs.note: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
(I also baptized the household of Stephanas; besides them, I don’t know whether I baptized any other.)
Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.
These are those who were not defiled with women, for they are virgins. These are those who follow the Lamb wherever he…

people.name: Achaia
people.line: A Roman province in southern Greece, including Corinth.

people.name: Stephanas
people.line: Corinthian believer, baptized by Paul, sent to visit him.

translations.web: Now I beg you, brothers—you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints—
translations.bsb: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,
translations.kjv: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
translations.asv: Now I beseech you, brethren (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to minister unto the saints),
